description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a Non-Material Amendment in connection with planning permission reference 24/2634/F dated 26.03.2026 for Demolition of all existing buildings and structures on site and the mixed-use redevelopment of the site to provide three buildings, including purpose-built student accommodation (Sui Generis), and commercial, business and service use (Use Class E), with basement level, access, parking, refuse and service areas, hard and soft landscaping, and associated works to vary Condition 2 (Approved drawings) to allow:Reduction in height of Building C by one storey and now comprises ground plus five storeys. Removal of secondary fire escape staircases in Buildings A, B and C, and associated optimisation to all three building cores, including stair and lift locations.Amendments to room mix and cluster distribution to ensure compliance with BS 9991:2024. Revisions to fa‡ade panels at ground level, level 1 and level 5.Minor reconfiguration at ground level as a result of revised core and service riser layouts.Reduction in commercial floorspace and increase to ground floor student amenity.Reduction in basement footprint as a result of core and service riser layout optimisation.Minor alteration at roof level, primarily to accommodate the repositioning of lift overruns.Corresponding amendments to conditions 30 (Refuse and Recycling) and 31 (Cycle Parking) to reflect revised plans.
